resources.string: AirScroll lets you scroll any app without touching the screen. When you turn it on, the front camera watches your hand: moving your finger up or down in the air scrolls the app you are using. This service is used only to perform those scroll gestures and to show the floating on/off button. It does not read your screen content, typing or passwords, and camera frames are processed on your device only – nothing is recorded or uploaded.
Scroll any app with finger gestures in the air
Shown while the camera is watching for hand gestures
Move your finger up or down in front of the camera to scroll
